subtitle: A Guide to the Parks, Squares, and Woodlands of the City of Light
author: Susan Cahill
source_file: Hidden Gardens of Paris- A Guide to the Parks, Squares, and -- Cahill, Susan Neunzig, Ranoux, Marion -- Illustrated, 1St Edition, First Edition, PT, -- 9780312673338 -- ce396ea4be28f32668698832bec2b039 -- Anna's Archive.pdf
notes: Re-split 2026-04-29 to keep every extraction sub-chunk under the ~500-line Sonnet stall threshold (Phase 3 wave 2 lost a 646-line chunk to that exact failure mode). Chunk-01 (front matter) is excluded from extraction. Chunks 02-08 each split into 2-3 sub-chunks at chapter boundaries; chunk-06a and chunk-08a were prepended with clean section headers because the original OCR banners were unreadable. Page numbers in source flow are unreliable; source_line_range refers to the form-feed-stripped extracted text.

chunks.summary: Cover, table of contents, dedication, copyright, and Susan Cahill's introduction. No POIs/beats — exclude from extraction.
Square du Vert Galant (Pont Neuf, Henri IV); Square Jean-XXIII (Notre-Dame cathedral gardens); Square René-Viviani (Saint-Julien-le-Pauvre, oldest tree in Paris).

chunks.section_title: Latin Quarter — Cluny to École Normale
chunks.summary: Jardins du Musée de Cluny (medieval Roman thermae); Square Paul-Langevin; L'École Normale Supérieure (students' garden, rue d'Ulm).

chunks.section_title: Latin Quarter — Arènes to Jardin des Plantes
chunks.summary: Square des Arènes de Lutèce (Roman amphitheater); Jardin des Plantes — Alpine Garden; nearby Mosque Garden, Institut du Monde Arabe, Jardin Tino Rossi.

chunks.section_title: Jardin du Luxembourg & Musée Eugène Delacroix
chunks.summary: Jardin du Luxembourg (Marie de' Medici palace and gardens, Medici Fountain); Musée Eugène Delacroix (place de Furstemberg).
Square Boucicaut (Bon Marché founder); Jardin de la Clinique Saint-Jean de Dieu; Musée Rodin (Hôtel Biron rue de Varenne).

chunks.section_title: Square Récamier, Champ de Mars, Square Santiago du Chili
chunks.summary: Square Récamier (rue de Sèvres); Champ de Mars (Eiffel Tower, École Militaire); Square Santiago du Chili (7th arr.).
Musée Zadkine (rue d'Assas); Jardin Atlantique (rooftop of Gare Montparnasse); Parc Georges-Brassens (former Vaugirard abattoirs); Parc Montsouris.

chunks.section_title: Western Paris — Bagatelle & Maison de Balzac
chunks.summary: Bois de Boulogne / Parc de Bagatelle (Comte d'Artois 1777 wager); Maison de Balzac (Passy, rue Raynouard).
Jardin des Tuileries (Catherine de' Medici, Le Nôtre); Palais-Royal (Cardinal Richelieu, Camille Desmoulins, Colette).

chunks.section_title: Vallée Suisse, Place des Vosges & Carnavalet
chunks.summary: La Vallée Suisse (Champs-Élysées rond-point hidden valley); Place des Vosges (Henri IV's Place Royale, Hugo at no. 6); Jardin du Musée Carnavalet (Hôtel de Carnavalet).

chunks.section_title: Marais — Square Georges-Cain & Square du Temple
chunks.summary: Square Georges-Cain (Marais sculpture garden); Square du Temple (Knights Templar precinct, Louis XVI prison).

chunks.section_title: Northern Paris — Monceau, Vie Romantique, Batignolles
chunks.summary: Parc Monceau (Philippe d'Orléans / Carmontelle's anglo-chinois folly park); Musée de la Vie Romantique (rue Chaptal); Square des Batignolles (Manet, Verlaine, Mallarmé).
Square Suzanne-Buisson (Saint-Denis legend, place Casadesus); Musée de Montmartre (12 rue Cortot, Renoir / Suzanne Valadon / Utrillo).
La Promenade Plantée (former Vincennes railway viaduct, Bastille opera); Bois de Vincennes — Parc Floral (Vincennes château, four-season gardens).

chunks.section_title: Bastille — Square Maurice-Gardette & Square de la Roquette
chunks.summary: Square Maurice-Gardette (11th arr. Resistance councilman); Square de la Roquette (former women's prison, Communard executions).
Parc des Buttes-Chaumont (Haussmann/Alphand 1867 quarry transformation); Père-Lachaise Cemetery (Colette, Wilde, Morrison, Mur des Fédérés).
